dimensions.requirements: 3 of 15 acceptance criteria FAIL (S0.3.3.2/3/4). Taxonomy and logging halves are complete and well tested.
dimensions.architecture_conformance: Conforms. observability imports no domain module; codes single-sourced; trace_id via ContextVar; api.md §4 envelope fields (code, retryable, trace_id, message) all available on VideoAgentError.
dimensions.regression_risk: Low for existing modules. config/errors.py migration to enum members is behaviour-preserving and tested.
dimensions.edge_cases: Strong on typed shapes (bytes/bytearray/memoryview/SecretStr/homoglyph keys). Weak on string-embedded secrets - the entire detector chain is anchored at token start.
dimensions.security: Two confirmed latent credential-disclosure paths (F1, F2) and one PII-window bypass (F3). No active leak at this commit because configure_logging is never called (F5), which is itself the concern.
dimensions.performance: scan_payload runs per record over the full payload plus per whitespace token; acceptable at current volumes, worth revisiting when hot paths log per shot.
dimensions.maintainability: Excellent. Every constant carries a spec reference; guards are importable functions driven from tests rather than workflow-only greps.
dimensions.test_coverage: 452 tests, 100% stmt+branch on observability, and 44/48 of my mutations caught. Gaps: exemption-list contents unpinned, ISO-BMFF fallback unexercised, no test for a secret preceded by punctuation.
dimensions.confidence: High. Every finding below was reproduced by execution against the committed code.
dimensions.improvements: Anchor detectors on substring search (re.finditer over a URL/secret pattern) rather than token-prefix match; split prompt_preview into its own FieldKind capped at PROMPT_PREVIEW_CHARS; pin PRE_LOGGING_BOOTSTRAP_PATHS by equality and add a stdout-in-bootstrap negative test; make get_logger fail loudly or lazily install when configure_logging has not run.
